items.title: 3.6.1 Properties of the Definite Integrals (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 96-101: 3.6.1 Property-I to Property-IX, Remember! box, Examples 49-56

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq (3.6) mein hum ne har definite integral lamba raasta le kar nikala: pehle antiderivative, phir limits. Aaj hum definite integrals ki properties (khaasiyat) seekhenge. Yeh shortcuts hain. Kuch properties (IV, V aur VI) to aisa kamaal karti hain ke jis integral ka antiderivative nikalna taqreeban na-mumkin ho, us ki value bhi do teen line mein aa jati hai. Examples 52, 53 aur 55 mein yahi hoga.

Aaj ke sabaq ka naqsha yeh hai: pehle nau properties (Property-I se Property-IX) ek ek kar ke, har ek ke saath us ki wajah aur ek chhoti si misaal; phir ek khulasa table ke kaun si property kab lagani hai; aur aakhir mein kitab ki aath misaalein (Example 49 se 56). Har misaal ke baad hum ruk kar dekhenge ke us se kya seekha. Copy aur pencil saath rakhiye aur har qadam khud bhi likhiye, kyun ke maths dekhne se nahi, karne se aata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har property ke saath hum ek teaching note mein dikhayenge ke woh sahi kyun hai. Is ke liye sirf do cheezein chahiye: \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = F(b) - F(a)\) aur substitution. Ratta lagane ki zaroorat nahi; agar wajah samajh aa gayi to property khud yaad reh jayegi.
Ek misaal: properties aise hain jaise shehar mein shortcut galiyan. Main sarak (antiderivative) se bhi manzil mil jati hai, magar galiyan pata hon to waqt bachta hai, aur kabhi kabhi main sarak band bhi hoti hai.
Kitab kehti hai: is poore hisse mein farz karein ke \(f\) diye gaye interval par continuous function hai.

Pehle teen properties (I, II, III) bilkul bunyaadi hain. Inhein aap aise samjhiye jaise ginti ke qaide: naam badalne se cheez nahi badalti, ulta chalne se sign ulta ho jata hai, aur raasta tukron mein baantne se kul faasla wahi rehta hai. Yeh teenon seedhi \(F(b) - F(a)\) se nikalti hain, is liye in ki wajah ek line mein samajh aa jati hai.
Property-I: \[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{a}^{b} f(t)\,dt.\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Variable ka harf (letter) koi farq nahi dalta: dono taraf \(F(b) - F(a)\) hi aata hai. Definite integral ke andar wala variable dummy variable kehlata hai, jaise class register mein roll number: naam badal dein, bacha wahi rehta hai. Substitution ke baad jab hum \(t\) ki jagah dobara \(x\) likhte hain (Examples 51 aur 56) to yahi property kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kyun: \(\int_{a}^{a} f(x)\,dx = F(a) - F(a) = 0\). Jis interval ki chaurai hi zero ho, us mein kuch jama nahi hota; jaise ek hi lamhe mein tanki mein koi paani nahi barhta.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
\(\int_{7}^{7} \frac{e^{x}\sin x}{1 + x^{4}}\,dx\) kitna hai? Integrand kitna hi lamba ho, dono limits barabar hain, is liye jawab seedha 0.
Yeh baat Property-II se bhi nikalti hai: agar \(I = \int_{a}^{a} f\) ho to limits ulatne se \(I = -I\), aur aisa sirf \(I = 0\) ke liye mumkin hai. Dekhiye, properties ek doosre se kaise jurri hui hain.
Property-II: \[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = -\int_{b}^{a} f(x)\,dx.\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: \(F(a) - F(b) = -\big(F(b) - F(a)\big)\). Limits ulat dein to sirf sign badalta hai.
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\int_{3}^{1} 2x\,dx = 1 - 9 = -8\), jab ke \(\int_{1}^{3} 2x\,dx = 8\).
Khud sochiye: \(\int_{5}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 7\) ho to \(\int_{2}^{5} f(x)\,dx\) kya hoga? (Jawab: \(-7\).)

Property-III: \[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx\]
\[= \int_{a}^{c} f(x)\,dx + \int_{c}^{b} f(x)\,dx,\]
where \(a < c < b\).

This result can be generalized as follows:
\[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{a}^{c_{1}} f(x)\,dx\]
\[+ \int_{c_{1}}^{c_{2}} f(x)\,dx + \int_{c_{2}}^{c_{3}} f(x)\,dx\]
\[+ \cdots + \int_{c_{n-1}}^{c_{n}} f(x)\,dx\]
\[+ \int_{c_{n}}^{b} f(x)\,dx\]
where \(a < c_{1} < c_{2} < c_{3} < \cdots < c_{n-1} < c_{n} < b\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: \(\big(F(c) - F(a)\big) + \big(F(b) - F(c)\big) = F(b) - F(a)\). Beech wale point \(c\) ki value ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus aa kar kat jati hai. Jaise Lahore se Islamabad ka safar Lahore se Gujranwala aur phir Gujranwala se Islamabad ke barabar hai.
Kab istemal karein: jab function tukron (pieces) mein diya ho (Example 49), jab absolute value ho (Example 50), ya 3.7 mein jab area ka kuch hissa x-axis ke upar aur kuch neeche ho. Interval ko theek wahan toriye jahan formula badalta hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar \(\int_{0}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 5\) aur \(\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx = 2\) ho to \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\) kitna hoga? Property-III ke mutabiq \(2 + \int_{1}^{3} f = 5\), to jawab 3.
Ab ulta sochiye: kya \(c\) ka \(a\) aur \(b\) ke darmiyan hona zaroori hai? Dar asal \(F(c)\) har haal mein kat jata hai, is liye formula tab bhi sahi rehta hai jab tak \(f\) un sab points par continuous ho; kitab sirf aam soorat \(a < c < b\) likhti hai.

Ab aati hain asal 'jaadu' wali properties: IV, V aur VI. In sab ki jaan symmetry (tawazun) hai. Idea yeh hai ke interval ko ulti taraf se parhein, ya beech se aaina rakh kar dekhein, to integrand ya to waisa hi rehta hai ya ulta ho jata hai. Dono soorton mein humein integrate kiye baghair bahut kuch pata chal jata hai. In properties ki wajah samajhne ke liye substitution (3.3 wali) aur limits badalne ka tareeqa (3.6 wala) chahiye.
Property-IV: \[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{a}^{b} f(a + b - x)\,dx.\]

items: (i) As a special case, if we take \(a = 0\), we obtain: \(\int_{0}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{b} f(b - x)\,dx\)
(ii) As another special case, if we take \(a = -b\), we obtain: \(\int_{-b}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{-b}^{b} f(-x)\,dx\).

(iii) For any integrand of the form \(\frac{f(x)}{f(x) + g(x)}\), if there exists a substitution \(x \to a + b - x\) such that \(f(a + b - x) = g(x)\) and \(g(a + b - x) = f(x)\), then \(\int_{a}^{b} \frac{f(x)}{f(x) + g(x)}\,dx = \frac{b - a}{2}\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Property-IV sahi kyun hai? \(x = a + b - t\) rakhiye, to \(dx = -dt\). Jab \(x = a\) to \(t = b\), aur jab \(x = b\) to \(t = a\).
\[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx = \int_{b}^{a} f(a + b - t)(-dt)\]
\[= \int_{a}^{b} f(a + b - t)\,dt\]
(Property-II ne minus hata kar limits seedhi kar deen), aur Property-I se \(t\) ki jagah \(x\) likh diya. Asaan alfaaz mein: \(a + b - x\) wahi interval ulti taraf se chalta hai, jaise foot rule ko doosre sire se parhna. Lambai wahi rehti hai.
(iii) mein \(\frac{b - a}{2}\) kyun aata hai? Integral ko \(I\) kahiye. Property-IV wala badlao \(f\) ko \(g\) aur \(g\) ko \(f\) bana deta hai, to
\[I = \int_{a}^{b} \dfrac{g(x)}{g(x) + f(x)}\,dx\]
Ab \(I\) ki dono shaklein jama karein:
\[2I = \int_{a}^{b} \dfrac{f(x) + g(x)}{f(x) + g(x)}\,dx\]
\[= \int_{a}^{b} 1\,dx = b - a\]
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}}\,dx = \frac{\pi}{4}\), kyun ke \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2} - x\) se \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) aapas mein jagah badal lete hain. Socho, is ka antiderivative dhoondna kitna mushkil hota!

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\int_{0}^{\pi} x\sin x\,dx\) ko Property-IV se dekhiye. \(x \to \pi - x\) karne se \(\sin(\pi - x) = \sin x\) rehta hai magar \(x\) ki jagah \(\pi - x\) aa jata hai. Dono shaklein jama karein to \(2I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin x\,dx = 2\pi\), yani \(I = \pi\).
Sawal: Property-IV kab faida deti hai? Jab badalne ke baad integrand ya to saada ho jaye, ya asal integrand ka 'saathi' ban jaye jise jama karne se kuch aasan cheez bane.

Property-V: \[\int_{-a}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} \big(f(x) + f(-x)\big)\,dx\]
In particular, if \(f(-x) = f(x)\) (that is, \(f\) is an even function), then
\[\int_{-a}^{a} f(x)\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx\]
and if \(f(-x) = -f(x)\) (that is, \(f\) is an odd function), then \(\int_{-a}^{a} f(x)\,dx = 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: \(\int_{-a}^{a} = \int_{-a}^{0} + \int_{0}^{a}\) mein toriye (Property-III) aur pehle hisse mein \(x = -t\) rakhiye; woh \(\int_{0}^{a} f(-t)\,dt\) ban jata hai.
Function ko test kaise karein: \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakhiye. Agar kuch na badle to even function (jaise \(x^{2}\), \(\cos x\), \(|x|\)). Agar sirf sign badle to odd function (jaise \(x^{3}\), \(\sin x\), \(\tan x\)).
Tasveer mein socho: even function ka graph y-axis ke dono taraf aaine (mirror) ki tarah ek jaisa hota hai, to dono hisse barabar; odd function ke dono hisse barabar magar ulte hote hain, to aapas mein kat jate hain, jaise kamaai aur kharch barabar hon to bachat zero.
Kaam ke usool: odd \(\times\) even = odd; odd \(\times\) odd = even; even \(\times\) even = even.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\int_{-2}^{2} x^{2}\,dx\). \(x^{2}\) even hai, to yeh \(2\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}\,dx = 2 \cdot \frac{8}{3} = \frac{16}{3}\) hai. Seedha nikal kar bhi dekhiye: \(\frac{8}{3} - \big(-\frac{8}{3}\big) = \frac{16}{3}\). Wahi jawab.
Aur \(\int_{-5}^{5} x^{3}\cos x\,dx\)? \(x^{3}\) odd, \(\cos x\) even, product odd: jawab foran 0, koi hisaab nahi.

Property-VI: \[\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a/2} \big(f(x) + f(a - x)\big)\,dx\]
In particular,
\[\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = 0 \;\text{ if } f(a - x) = -f(x)\]
\[\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{a/2} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\text{if } f(a - x) = f(x)\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: interval ko beech se toriye, \(\int_{0}^{a} = \int_{0}^{a/2} + \int_{a/2}^{a}\), aur doosre hisse mein \(x = a - t\) rakhiye; woh \(\int_{0}^{a/2} f(a - t)\,dt\) ban jata hai.
Agar \(f(a - x) = -f(x)\) ho to doosra aadha pehle aadhe ko kaat deta hai, jawab 0. Agar \(f(a - x) = f(x)\) ho to dono aadhe barabar, jawab ek aadhe ka do guna. Example 52 mein dono soorten aayengi.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(f(-x)\) nahi balke \(f(a - x)\) check karna hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se misaal: \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \cos x\,dx\). Yahan \(a = \pi\) aur \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\), to Property-VI kehti hai jawab 0. Seedha check: \(\big[\sin x\big]_{0}^{\pi} = 0 - 0 = 0\).
Ab \(\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin x\,dx\) sochiye: \(\sin(\pi - x) = \sin x\), to yeh \(2\int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin x\,dx = 2(1) = 2\) hai. Graph mein bhi dekhiye: \(\sin x\) ka pahaar \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke dono taraf ek jaisa hai.

Aakhri teen properties (VII, VIII, IX) hisaab lagane se zyada samajh aur tasdeeq ke kaam aati hain. VII aur VIII batati hain ke integral ka sign kya hoga aur do integrals mein kaun bara hai, wo bhi bina value nikale. IX batati hai ke jama aur constant ke saath integral kaise behave karta hai. In ko 'sanity check' samajhiye: jawab nikalne ke baad dekh lijiye ke woh in properties ke khilaaf to nahi.
Property-VII: If \(f(x) \ge 0\) on the interval \([a, b]\), then \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx \ge 0\) and if \(f(x) \le 0\) on the interval \([c, d]\), then \(\int_{c}^{d} f(x)\,dx \le 0\).
Property-VIII: If \(f(x) \le g(x)\) on \([a, b]\), then \(\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx \le \int_{a}^{b} g(x)\,dx\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab mein Property-VIII ke daayen integral ki lower limit \(c\) chhapi hai: \(\int_{c}^{b} g(x)\,dx\). Yeh ghalat hai, kyun ke muqabla ek hi interval \([a, b]\) par ho raha hai. Sahi:
\[\int_{a}^{b} f(x)\,dx \le \int_{a}^{b} g(x)\,dx\]
Upar hum ne sahi shakal likhi hai.

Property-IX: \[\int_{a}^{b} \big(\alpha f_{1}(x) + \beta f_{2}(x)\big)\,dx\]
\[= \alpha\int_{a}^{b} f_{1}(x)\,dx + \beta\int_{a}^{b} f_{2}(x)\,dx.\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Property-VII: jo function kabhi x-axis se neeche na jaye, us ka integral (\(a < b\) ke saath) negative nahi ho sakta. Jawab ka sign check karne ke liye yeh bahut kaam ki hai.
Property-VIII isi se nikalti hai: \([a, b]\) par \(g - f \ge 0\) hai, to \(\int_{a}^{b} (g - f)\,dx \ge 0\). Yani jo function har jagah bara ho, us ka integral bhi bara.
Property-IX (linearity): jama ko term by term integrate karo aur constants ko bahar nikal lo, bilkul indefinite integrals ki tarah.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Bina hisaab ke batayein: \(\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}\,dx\) bara hai ya \(\int_{0}^{1} x\,dx\)? \([0, 1]\) par \(x^{2} \le x\) (jaise \(0.5^{2} = 0.25 < 0.5\)), to Property-VIII ke mutabiq pehla chhota hai: \(\frac{1}{3} \le \frac{1}{2}\).
Aur agar \(\int_{a}^{b} f = 3\) aur \(\int_{a}^{b} g = 4\) ho to \(\int_{a}^{b} (2f - 5g)\,dx = 2(3) - 5(4) = -14\) (Property-IX).

rows: Variable sirf naam hai; value sirf \(f\), \(a\) aur \(b\) par munhasir hai.
Lower limit upper se bari ho, ya limits ko seedhi tarteeb mein laana ho.
Function tukron mein diya ho, \(|\;|\) ho, ya sign badalta ho (Examples 49, 50).
Badalne se integrand saada ya mutaliq shakal mein aa jaye (\(x \leftrightarrow 1 - x\), \(\sin \leftrightarrow \cos\)) (Examples 51, 53).
Pehle \(f(-x)\) check karein: even ho to \(2\int_{0}^{a}\), odd ho to 0 (Example 55).
\(f(a - x) = -f(x)\) ho to 0; \(f(a - x) = f(x)\) ho to \(2\int_{0}^{a/2}\) (Example 52).
Integral nikale baghair us ka sign ya do integrals ka muqabla chahiye.
Jama ko alag alag integrals mein torna aur constants bahar nikalna.
blocks.caption: Hamara khulasa (kitab mein nahi): kaun si property kab

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Exam mein definite integral dekh kar pehle limits par nazar daaliye, phir integrand par:
1. Limits \(-a\) se \(a\)? Foran \(f(-x)\) check kijiye (Property-V).
2. Limits \(0\) se \(a\), ya \(a\) se \(b\), aur integrand mein \(\sin\)/\(\cos\) ya \(x\)/\(1 - x\) ka joda? \(x \to a + b - x\) aazmaiye (Property-IV, VI).
3. Absolute value ya tukron wala function? Interval toriye (Property-III).
4. Function ka formula hi na diya ho? Di hui maloomat aur properties ko jor kar equation banaiye (Examples 54, 56).
Agar in mein se kuch na lage tab seedha antiderivative wala raasta lijiye. Yeh tarteeb aap ka bahut waqt bachayegi.
Ab misaalon ki taraf chalte hain. Pehli do misaalein Property-III (interval torna) ki hain. Dono mein asal kaam yeh pehchanna hai ke formula kahan badalta hai.

blocks.title: Example 49
blocks.problem: Let \(f(x) = \begin{cases} x^{2} & \text{if } 0 \le x < 2 \\ 4 - x & \text{if } 2 \le x \le 4 \end{cases}\) Compute: \(\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(0 \le x < 2\) par \(f(x) = x^{2}\), aur \(2 \le x \le 4\) par \(f(x) = 4 - x\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(x = 2\) par formula badal jata hai, to wahin interval toriye (Property-III) aur har tukre ko us ke apne formula se integrate kijiye. Ek hi formula poore \([0, 4]\) par lagana ghalat hoga.

Step 1: \(x = 2\) par toriye
\[\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\; + \int_{2}^{4} f(x)\,dx\]
\[= \int_{0}^{2} x^{2}\,dx + \int_{2}^{4} (4 - x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property-III mein \(c = 2\) liya; ab har tukre par \(f\) ka ek hi formula hai.

Step 2: Pehla tukra
\[\int_{0}^{2} x^{2}\,dx = \Big[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\Big]_{0}^{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{(2)^{3}}{3} - \dfrac{(0)^{3}}{3} = \dfrac{8}{3} - 0\]
Kyun: power rule, \(\int x^{2}\,dx = \frac{x^{3}}{3}\); upar 2 rakha, neeche 0.

Step 3: Doosra tukra
\[\int_{2}^{4} (4 - x)\,dx = \Big[4x - \dfrac{x^{2}}{2}\Big]_{2}^{4}\]
\[= \Big(4(4) - \dfrac{(4)^{2}}{2}\Big) - \Big(4(2) - \dfrac{(2)^{2}}{2}\Big)\]
\[= (16 - 8) - (8 - 2)\]
\[= 8 - 6 = 2\]
Kyun: \(\int 4\,dx = 4x\) aur \(\int x\,dx = \frac{x^{2}}{2}\); phir upar wali value minus neeche wali.
Dhyan dein: \((8 - 2)\) bracket ke saath ghataiye; \(16 - 8 - 8 - 2\) likhna ghalat hoga.

Step 4: Dono jama karein
\[\int_{0}^{4} f(x)\,dx = \dfrac{8}{3} + 2\]
\[= \dfrac{8 + 6}{3} = \dfrac{14}{3}\]
Kyun: \(2 = \frac{6}{3}\) likh kar denominator ek jaisa kiya.

Tasdeeq: \([2, 4]\) par \(4 - x\) ka graph \((2, 2)\) se \((4, 0)\) tak seedhi lakeer hai, yani ek triangle jis ka area \(\frac{1}{2}(2)(2) = 2\) hai. Wahi jawab. \(\checkmark\)
Kul \(\frac{8}{3} + 2 = \frac{14}{3} \approx 4.667\).

blocks.text: Is misaal se kya seekha: jab function tukron mein diya ho to har tukre ko apne formula ke saath alag integrate karna hai, aur tukre wahin karne hain jahan formula badalta hai. Ek aur baat: seedhi lakeer wale hisse ka integral geometry (triangle ya trapezium ka area) se check ho sakta hai. Exam mein yeh chhoti si tasdeeq aksar ghalti pakar leti hai.

blocks.title: Example 50
steps:
Diya gaya: \([-6, 4]\) par \(f(x) = |x - 1| + |x + 2|\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-6}^{4} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: absolute value (modulus) ka koi ek antiderivative formula nahi hota. Is liye pehle dekhenge ke bars ke andar wale expressions kahan sign badalte hain, wahan interval torenge (Property-III), aur har tukre par \(f\) ko bars ke baghair likhenge.

Step 1: Andar wale kahan zero hote hain
\[x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
\[x + 2 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -2\]
To \([-6, 4]\) ko \(x = -6, -2, 1, 4\) par toriye. Teen tukre bante hain: \([-6, -2]\), \([-2, 1]\), \([1, 4]\).
Kyun: \(|u| = u\) jab \(u \ge 0\), aur \(|u| = -u\) jab \(u < 0\). Formula sirf wahan badal sakta hai jahan \(u = 0\) ho.

Step 2: (a) \(x \in [-6, -2]\) ke liye
\[|x - 1| = -(x - 1) = -x + 1\]
\[|x + 2| = -(x + 2) = -x - 2\]
\[f(x) = -x + 1 - x - 2 = -2x - 1\]
\[\int_{-6}^{-2} (-2x - 1)\,dx = \Big[-\dfrac{2x^{2}}{2} - x\Big]_{-6}^{-2}\]
\[= \Big[-x^{2} - x\Big]_{-6}^{-2}\]
\[= (-4 + 2) - (-36 + 6)\]
\[= -2 - (-30) = -2 + 30 = 28\]
Kyun: yahan \(x - 1\) bhi negative aur \(x + 2\) bhi zero ya negative, to dono bars aage minus laga dete hain. Misaal ke taur par \(x = -4\) rakh kar dekhiye: \(|-5| = 5 = -(-5)\).
Dhyan dein: \((-4 + 2) - (-36 + 6)\) mein doosra bracket \(-30\) hai, aur minus minus plus ban kar \(+30\).

Step 3: (b) \(x \in [-2, 1]\) ke liye
\[|x - 1| = -(x - 1) = -x + 1\]
\[|x + 2| = x + 2\]
\[f(x) = -x + 1 + x + 2 = 3\]
\[\int_{-2}^{1} 3\,dx = \big[3x\big]_{-2}^{1}\]
\[= 3(1) - 3(-2) = 3 + 6 = 9\]
Kyun: yahan \(x - 1 \le 0\) magar \(x + 2 \ge 0\). \(x\) wale terms kat gaye aur \(f\) sirf constant 3 reh gaya; is ka integral seedha 3 \(\times\) chaurai hai.

Step 5: (a), (b), (c) jama karein
\[\int_{-6}^{4} f\,dx = \int_{-6}^{-2} f\,dx\]
\[\; + \int_{-2}^{1} f\,dx + \int_{1}^{4} f\,dx\]
\[= 28 + 9 + 18 = 55\]
Kyun: Property-III, do jagah se tora hua interval.

Tasdeeq: har tukre par graph seedhi lakeer hai, to har integral ek trapezium ya rectangle ka area hai.
\[[-6, -2]:\ \tfrac{11 + 3}{2}\times 4 = 28\]
\[[-2, 1]:\ 3 \times 3 = 9\]
\[[1, 4]:\ \tfrac{3 + 9}{2}\times 3 = 18\]
\(28 + 9 + 18 = 55\); sympy bhi 55 deta hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Example 50 mein teen chhapai ki ghaltiyan hain:
1. Tukre \([-6, 2]\), \([-2, 1]\), \([1, 4]\) chhape hain. Pehla tukra \([-6, -2]\) hai (kitab ka apna part (a) bhi \([-6, -2]\) use karta hai).
2. Part (c) mein sirf \(|x - 1|\) chhapa hai, \(= x - 1\) reh gaya hai.
3. Aakhri jama \(28 + 9 + 18 = 57\) chhapi hai. Sahi jama 55 hai, yani \(\int_{-6}^{4} f(x)\,dx = 55\).

Is misaal se kya seekha: absolute value dekhte hi pehla kaam andar wale ko zero ke barabar rakh kar 'tootne ke points' nikalna hai. Phir har tukre mein ek aasaan point (jaise \(x = -4\), \(x = 0\), \(x = 2\)) rakh kar dekhiye ke andar wala positive hai ya negative. Aur aakhir mein jama ehtiyaat se kijiye; kitab khud yahan ghalti kar gayi.
Ab Property-IV ki baari hai. Agli misaal mein dekhiye ke sirf \(x\) ko \(1 - x\) se badalne se ek mushkil integral kaise aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 51
steps:
Diya gaya: \(I = \int_{0}^{1} x^{2}(1 - x)^{\frac{3}{2}}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: \(I\) ki value.
Tareeqa: \((1 - x)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) ek binomial ki fractional power hai; ise khola nahi ja sakta. Property-IV (\(a = 0\), \(b = 1\)) se \(x\) ki jagah \(1 - x\) rakhenge. Is se fractional power akele \(x\) par aa jayegi, aur sab kuch \(x\) ki saada powers ban jayega jinhein power rule se integrate karna aasan hai.

Step 2: Zarb kar ke kholiye
\[= \int_{0}^{1} \Big(x^{\frac{3}{2}} - 2x^{\frac{5}{2}} + x^{\frac{7}{2}}\Big)dx\]
Kyun: same base ki powers zarb hon to powers jama hoti hain: \(x \cdot x^{\frac{3}{2}} = x^{1 + \frac{3}{2}} = x^{\frac{5}{2}}\), aur \(x^{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}} = x^{\frac{7}{2}}\).

Step 3: Integrate kar ke limits rakhein
\[= \Big[\tfrac{2}{5}x^{\frac{5}{2}} - \tfrac{4}{7}x^{\frac{7}{2}} + \tfrac{2}{9}x^{\frac{9}{2}}\Big]_{0}^{1}\]
\[= \Big(\tfrac{2}{5} - \tfrac{4}{7} + \tfrac{2}{9}\Big) - (0)\]
Kyun: power rule. Misaal: \(\int x^{\frac{3}{2}}\,dx = \frac{x^{5/2}}{5/2} = \frac{2}{5}x^{\frac{5}{2}}\). \(x = 1\) par har power 1 hai, aur \(x = 0\) par har term 0.
Dhyan dein: \(-2x^{\frac{5}{2}}\) ka integral \(-2 \cdot \frac{2}{7}x^{\frac{7}{2}} = -\frac{4}{7}x^{\frac{7}{2}}\) hai; 2 ko bhooliye mat.

Tasdeeq: sympy dono shaklon \(\int_{0}^{1} x^{2}(1 - x)^{\frac{3}{2}}\,dx\) aur \(\int_{0}^{1} (1 - x)^{2}x^{\frac{3}{2}}\,dx\) ko \(\frac{16}{315} \approx 0.0508\) deta hai. \([0, 1]\) par integrand positive aur zyada se zyada taqreeban 0.09 hai, to chhota positive jawab bilkul theek hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.text: Is misaal se kya seekha: jab \((1 - x)\) ki koi ajeeb power ho aur limits 0 se 1 hon, to Property-IV se \(x\) aur \(1 - x\) ki jagah badal dijiye. Mushkil power akele \(x\) par aa jati hai aur baqi polynomial khul jata hai. Yahi chaal \(\int_{0}^{1} x(1 - x)^{n}\,dx\) jaise sawalon mein bhi chalti hai.
Agli misaal mein Property-VI do dafa lagegi. \(\cos^{5} x\) ko khol kar integrate karna bahut lamba kaam hai, lekin symmetry se jawab ek minute mein aata hai.

blocks.title: Example 52
steps:
Diya gaya: \(I = \int_{0}^{2\pi} \cos^{5} x\,dx\).
Maloom karna: \(I\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Property-VI do dafa: pehle \(a = 2\pi\) ke saath, phir \(a = \pi\) ke saath. Har dafa \(f(a - x)\) ko \(f(x)\) se milayenge.

Step 1: Property-VI, \(a = 2\pi\)
\[f(x) = \cos^{5} x\]
\[f(2\pi - x) = \big[\cos(2\pi - x)\big]^{5}\]
\[= (\cos x)^{5} = \cos^{5} x = f(x)\]
\[\therefore\; I = 2\int_{0}^{\pi} \cos^{5} x\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\cos(2\pi - x) = \cos x\) (poora chakkar ghoomne se cos nahi badalta). To \(f(a - x) = f(x)\), aur integral pehle aadhe \([0, \pi]\) ka do guna hai.

Step 2: Property-VI, \(a = \pi\)
\[f(\pi - x) = \big(\cos(\pi - x)\big)^{5}\]
\[= (-\cos x)^{5} = -\cos^{5} x = -f(x)\]
\[\int_{0}^{\pi} \cos^{5} x\,dx = 0\]
Kyun: \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\), aur odd power (5) minus ko qaim rakhti hai: \((-1)^{5} = -1\). To \(f(\pi - x) = -f(x)\), aur \([0, \pi]\) par integral 0 hai.
Dhyan dein: agar power even hoti (jaise \(\cos^{4} x\)) to minus khatam ho jata aur jawab zero na hota.

Step 3: Natija
\[I = 2 \times 0\]
\[I = \int_{0}^{2\pi} \cos^{5} x\,dx = 0\]
Kyun: zero ka do guna zero.

Tasdeeq: \([0, \pi]\) par \(\cos^{5} x\) ka graph \([0, \frac{\pi}{2}]\) par axis ke upar aur \([\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi]\) par bilkul usi shakal mein neeche hai; dono hisse kat jate hain. Sympy bhi 0 deta hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Example 52 sirf integral \(\int_{0}^{2\pi} \cos^{5} x\,dx\) ki shakal mein chhapa hai, koi hidayat (Evaluate) nahi likhi. Matlab yahi hai ke is ki value nikalni hai, jaisa hum ne upar likha.

Is misaal se kya seekha: \([0, 2\pi]\) ya \([0, \pi]\) jaisi limits aur trigonometric function ho to pehle \(f(a - x)\) check kijiye. Agar \(f(a - x) = -f(x)\) mile to jawab bina integration ke zero hai. Yaad rakhiye ke \(\cos^{5}\) ki odd power ne minus sign bachaya; isi wajah se jawab zero aaya.
Ab ek khoobsurat misaal: is integral ka antiderivative dhoondna taqreeban na-mumkin hai, magar Property-IV se jawab zero saabit ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 53
steps:
Diya gaya: upar wala integral \(I\), jahan \(a = \frac{\pi}{5}\) aur \(b = \frac{3\pi}{10}\).
Maloom karna (saabit karna): \(I = 0\).
Tareeqa: Property-IV, \(x \to a + b - x\). Yahan \(a + b = \frac{\pi}{2}\), aur \(x\) ki jagah \(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\) rakhne se \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) aapas mein jagah badal lete hain. Numerator ka sign ulat jayega aur denominator wahi rahega, to \(I = -I\) milega.

Step 1: Hisson ke naam rakhein
\[D(x) = \sqrt{2 + \sin^{2}x\cos^{2}x}\]
\[I = \int_{\pi/5}^{3\pi/10} \dfrac{\sqrt{\sin x} - \sqrt{\cos x}}{D(x)}\,dx\]
\[a + b = \dfrac{\pi}{5} + \dfrac{3\pi}{10} = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: denominator ko chhota naam \(D(x)\) dene se lines chhoti rehti hain; aur \(a + b\) nikaal kar pata chala ke substitution \(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\) hogi.

Step 2: Substitution kya karti hai
\[\sin\Big(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - x\Big) = \cos x\]
\[\cos\Big(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - x\Big) = \sin x\]
\[D\Big(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - x\Big) = \sqrt{2 + \cos^{2}x\sin^{2}x}\]
\[= D(x)\]
Kyun: complementary angles ki identities. Denominator mein \(\sin^{2}x\cos^{2}x\) ka product hai, aur product mein factors ki jagah badalne se kuch nahi badalta (\(2 \times 3 = 3 \times 2\)).

Step 3: Property-IV lagayein
\[I = \int_{\pi/5}^{3\pi/10} \dfrac{\sqrt{\cos x} - \sqrt{\sin x}}{D(x)}\,dx\]
\[= -\int_{\pi/5}^{3\pi/10} \dfrac{\sqrt{\sin x} - \sqrt{\cos x}}{D(x)}\,dx\]
\[= -I\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{\cos x} - \sqrt{\sin x} = -\big(\sqrt{\sin x} - \sqrt{\cos x}\big)\); minus bahar nikala to baqi wahi asal integral \(I\) bacha.

Step 4: \(I\) nikalein
\[I = -I \Rightarrow 2I = 0 \Rightarrow I = 0\]
Kyun: sirf zero hi aisa number hai jo apne negative ke barabar ho. \(I\) ko dono taraf jama kiya to \(2I = 0\).

Tasdeeq: \([\frac{\pi}{5}, \frac{3\pi}{10}]\) yani 36 se 54 degree par \(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) dono positive hain, to roots real hain. Interval \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) (45 degree) ke gird symmetric hai; \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) se pehle numerator negative aur baad mein positive hai. Numerical integration bhi 0 deta hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.text: Is misaal se kya seekha: jab limits ka jama \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ho to \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2} - x\) se \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\) jagah badalte hain. Agar badalne ke baad integral apna hi negative ban jaye to woh zero hai. Is tarah ke 'show that ... = 0' sawal exam mein bahut aate hain, aur in mein antiderivative dhoondne ki koshish waqt zaya karti hai.
Agli misaal mein function \(f\) ka formula hi nahi diya! Aise mein hum ek identity dhoondte hain jo teenon integrals ko jor de.

blocks.title: Example 54
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{-3}^{3} \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^{x}}\,dx = 4\) aur \(\int_{-3}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 10\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{-3}^{3} \frac{f(x)}{1 + e^{-x}}\,dx\).
Tareeqa: \(f\) maloom nahi, to seedha integrate nahi kar sakte. Ek identity dhoondenge jo teenon integrands ko jor de, phir Property-IX (linearity) lagayenge.

Step 1: Asal identity
\[\dfrac{1}{1 + e^{-x}} = \dfrac{e^{x}}{e^{x} + 1}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{1 + e^{x}} + \dfrac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{1 + e^{x}} + \dfrac{e^{x}}{1 + e^{x}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + e^{x}}{1 + e^{x}} = 1\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}\) ke upar neeche \(e^{x}\) se zarb diya, kyun ke \(e^{-x}\cdot e^{x} = 1\). Ab dono fractions ka denominator \(1 + e^{x}\) hai aur jama 1 aata hai.

Step 2: Identity ko \(f(x)\) se zarb dein
\[\dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{x}} + \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{-x}} = f(x)\]
Kyun: is se na-maloom integrand aur diye hue dono integrands ek equation mein aa gaye.

Step 3: \([-3, 3]\) par integrate karein
\[\int_{-3}^{3} \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{x}}\,dx\]
\[\; + \int_{-3}^{3} \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{-x}}\,dx\]
\[= \int_{-3}^{3} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property-IX: jama ka integral, integrals ka jama hota hai.

Step 4: Di hui values rakhein
\[4 + \int_{-3}^{3} \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{-x}}\,dx = 10\]
\[\int_{-3}^{3} \dfrac{f(x)}{1 + e^{-x}}\,dx = 10 - 4 = 6\]
Kyun: pehla integral 4 diya hai aur daayan hissa 10.

Tasdeeq: \(4 + 6 = 10\) \(\checkmark\). Hamari taraf se misaal \(f(x) = x^{2} + 1\) le kar numerical integration bhi dikhata hai ke dono fraction wale integrals ka jama \(\int_{-3}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 24\) hai.

blocks.text: Is misaal se kya seekha: jab function ka formula na diya ho, to integrands ke darmiyan koi rishta (identity) dhoondiye. \(\frac{1}{1 + e^{x}} + \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}} = 1\) ek mash-hoor identity hai; ise yaad rakhiye, kyun ke \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) wale bahut se sawal isi se hal hote hain.
Ab Property-V ki misaal. Limits \(-a\) se \(a\) dekhte hi pehla sawal yeh hona chahiye: function even hai ya odd?

blocks.title: Example 55
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{-a}^{a} \frac{x^{3}\sin^{2}x}{x^{4} + 2x^{2} + 1}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: is ki value.
Tareeqa: limits symmetric hain (\(-a\) se \(a\)), to pehle test karenge ke integrand even hai ya odd (Property-V). Is ka antiderivative nikalna bahut mushkil hota.

Step 1: \(f(-x)\) check karein
\[f(x) = \dfrac{x^{3}\sin^{2}x}{x^{4} + 2x^{2} + 1}\]
\[f(-x) = \dfrac{(-x)^{3}\sin^{2}(-x)}{(-x)^{4} + 2(-x)^{2} + 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{-x^{3}\sin^{2}x}{x^{4} + 2x^{2} + 1} = -f(x)\]
Kyun: \((-x)^{3} = -x^{3}\); \(\sin(-x) = -\sin x\), to \(\sin^{2}(-x) = \sin^{2}x\); aur \(-x\) ki even powers \(x\) ki even powers ke barabar. Natija: \(f(-x) = -f(x)\), yani \(f\) odd hai.

Step 2: Property-V (odd function)
\[\int_{-a}^{a} \dfrac{x^{3}\sin^{2}x}{x^{4} + 2x^{2} + 1}\,dx = 0\]
Kyun: symmetric interval \([-a, a]\) par odd function ka \([-a, 0]\) wala hissa \([0, a]\) wale hisse ko kaat deta hai.

Tasdeeq: odd \(\times\) even \(\div\) even = odd: \(x^{3}\) odd, \(\sin^{2}x\) even, \(x^{4} + 2x^{2} + 1 = (x^{2} + 1)^{2}\) even aur kabhi zero nahi. \(a = 2\) le kar numerical integration bhi 0 deta hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.text: Is misaal se kya seekha: limits \(-a\) se \(a\) hon to sab se pehle odd/even test kijiye. Har factor ko alag check karna asaan hai: \(x^{3}\) odd, \(\sin^{2}x\) even, denominator even. Odd factors ki tadaad odd ho to poora function odd. Integrand kitna hi daraonay wala lage, odd ho to jawab zero.
Aakhri misaal mein kai properties ek saath lagti hain: VI, substitution, I, aur V. Isay ek chhoti si paheli samajh kar hal karte hain.

blocks.title: Example 56
blocks.problem: Given \(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 4\) and \(f(2 - x) = f(x) = f(-x)\). Evaluate \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 4\) aur \(f(2 - x) = f(x) = f(-x)\).
Maloom karna: \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\).
Tareeqa: Property-VI se \(\int_{0}^{1} f\) milega; substitution \(x = 2 - t\) interval \([1, 3]\) ko \([-1, 1]\) par le aayegi; phir \(f\) ka even hona (Property-V) kaam poora kar dega.

Step 1: Property-VI, \(a = 2\)
\[f(2 - x) = f(x)\]
\[\Rightarrow \int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 2\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx\]
\[4 = 2\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx\]
\[\Rightarrow \int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx = 2\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\) ke saath \(f(a - x) = f(x)\) diya hai, to integral pehle aadhe \([0, 1]\) ka do guna hai.

Step 2: \(x = 2 - t\) rakhein
\[x = 2 - t,\quad dx = -dt\]
\[x = 1:\ t = 1;\qquad x = 3:\ t = -1\]
\[\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx = \int_{1}^{-1} f(2 - t)(-dt)\]
\[= -\int_{-1}^{1} f(2 - t)(-dt)\]
\[= \int_{-1}^{1} f(2 - t)\,dt\]
Kyun: \(dx = -dt\); nayi limits \(t = 2 - 1 = 1\) aur \(t = 2 - 3 = -1\). Property-II ne limits ulat kar ek minus khatam kar diya.
Dhyan dein: \(dx = -dt\) wala minus bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Step 3: \(f(2 - x) = f(x)\) istemal karein
\[= \int_{-1}^{1} f(2 - x)\,dx\]
\[= \int_{-1}^{1} f(x)\,dx\]
Kyun: Property-I se \(t\) ki jagah \(x\) likha, aur \(f(2 - x) = f(x)\) diya hua hai.

Step 4: \(f\) even hai
\[= 2\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx = 2(2) = 4\]
Kyun: \(f(-x) = f(x)\) aur limits \(-1\) se 1 symmetric hain (Property-V); Step 1 se \(\int_{0}^{1} f(x)\,dx = 2\).

Tasdeeq: \(f(2 - x) = f(-x)\) mein \(y = -x\) rakhein to \(f(y + 2) = f(y)\), yani \(f\) har 2 units ke baad dohrata hai (jaise ghari ki suiyan har 12 ghante baad). \([1, 3]\) bhi \([0, 2]\) ki tarah ek poora daur hai, is liye integral phir 4. Hamari taraf se misaal: \(f(x) = 2 + \cos\pi x\) saari sharten poori karta hai, aur sympy \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx = 4\) deta hai. \(\checkmark\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Example 56 ka sawal sirf 'Evaluate \(\int_{1}^{3} f(x)\,dx\)' chhapa hai; zaroori maloomat (\(\int_{0}^{2} f(x)\,dx = 4\) aur \(f(2 - x) = f(x) = f(-x)\)) sirf hal ke andar likhi hain. Poora sawal woh hai jo hum ne upar likha.

Is misaal se kya seekha: ek sawal mein kai properties ek saath lag sakti hain. Har qadam par poochiye: mere paas kya diya hai (\(f(2 - x) = f(x)\), \(f(-x) = f(x)\)) aur kaun si property usay istemal karti hai. Substitution mein \(dx = -dt\) aur nayi limits ka khayal rakhiye.

Chaliye aaj ka sabaq dohra lete hain. Pehli teen properties (I, II, III) saada hain magar har jagah kaam aati hain. Property-IV, V aur VI symmetry ki taaqat hain: integral nikale baghair sirf \(f(-x)\), \(f(a - x)\) ya \(f(a + b - x)\) dekh kar jawab mil jata hai. Exam mein jab bhi limits khaas hon (\(-a\) se \(a\), \(0\) se \(\pi\), ya \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) jama karne wali), to pehle in properties ka socho, phir lamba raasta.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\int_{a}^{a} f = 0\); limits ulatne se sign badalta hai; variable ka harf koi farq nahi dalta.
2. Jahan formula badle wahan interval toro: tukron wale functions aur absolute values.
3. Property-IV, \(x \to a + b - x\): \([0, 1]\) par \(x\) aur \(1 - x\) jagah badalte hain; \(a + b = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ho to \(\sin\) aur \(\cos\). Integral \(-I\) ban jaye to \(I = 0\); saathi integral ban jaye to dono jama karo.
4. Symmetric limits \([-a, a]\): even ho to \(2\int_{0}^{a}\), odd ho to 0. Hamesha pehle \(f(-x)\) check karo.
5. \([0, a]\) par Property-VI: \(f(a - x) = -f(x)\) ho to 0; \(f(a - x) = f(x)\) ho to \(2\int_{0}^{a/2}\).
6. Jawab: Example 49: \(\frac{14}{3}\); 50: 55; 51: \(\frac{16}{315}\); 52, 53, 55: 0; 54: 6; 56: 4.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(|x - 1|\) ko bars ke baghair integrate kar dena. Pehle andar wale ke zero par interval toro.
2. Substitution ke baad purani limits rakhna, ya \(dx = -dt\) ka minus kho dena.
3. Ghair-symmetric limits (jaise \(\int_{-1}^{2}\)) par Property-V laga dena.
4. Har factor check kiye baghair function ko odd keh dena: \(\sin^{2}x\) even hai, odd nahi.
5. Property-VI mein \(f(a - x)\) ki jagah \(f(-x)\) check karna.
6. Tukre jama karte hue hisaab ki ghalti (kitab khud Example 50 mein 55 ki jagah 57 chhapti hai).
